font.reason: Neutral variable product-UI sans, the right register for a raycast-style voice-input capsule. This comp draws no glyphs at all (the original has zero on-screen text), so nothing can silently fall back; the family is declared through FaRoot so direction:rtl and a correct Persian face are in place for any inherited content.

textTranslation.note: The original contains NO on-screen strings: a grayscale mic emoji (script-neutral placeholder per the source prompt), an up-arrow SVG submit glyph, and 64 waveform bars. Nothing was translated because there is nothing to translate; no Persian label was invented because adding UI copy would change the composition and break faithfulness. Verified frame-by-frame: no Latin/Chinese text visible in any frame of the Persian render.
textTranslation.timingImpact: none (no text, no per-character effects; every frame timing, seed, easing curve, fps and size unchanged)

rtlDecisions.what: Capsule inner flex row order (mic | waveform | submit)
rtlDecisions.action: MIRRORED via direction:rtl from FaRoot: mic now at the RIGHT edge (reading start), submit at the LEFT edge (reading end).
rtlDecisions.why: The row is an input->commit flow that follows reading direction, exactly like the mirrored header in the reference ai-stream-response localization. Both 96px buttons keep flexShrink:0 so the mirrored row cannot shrink the icons.

rtlDecisions.what: Waveform scroll direction (newest sample at right end, history flowing right->left)
rtlDecisions.action: KEPT bit-exactly; the bars container is an explicit direction:'ltr' island inside the mirrored capsule. Per-bar sample math (sampleT = f - (N-1-i)*1.6, mulberry32 seeds, sin^0.8 center weight, 5px silence clamp) untouched.
rtlDecisions.why: The lessons doc lists waveform/music time direction as physical/universal (KEEP), and the source prompt names the right->left scroll a core design trait; it also coincides with Persian reading direction. A naive rtl flex would have silently reversed bar order (newest at the left), flipping the scroll to left->right and contradicting the design.
Universal send/commit glyph; no reading-direction meaning (not a back/next chevron).

rtlDecisions.what: Background radial light drift translate(+0.6f, +0.25f) and 180deg capsule border gradient
rtlDecisions.why: Physical light-source motion and a vertical gradient carry no reading-direction semantics.
Script-neutral pictograph; the source prompt itself notes it is a placeholder to be swapped for an SVG icon in production, not a localization concern.

rasterHandling: None needed: the original uses no raster/video assets (pure DOM/SVG/emoji on a dark gradient field). Nothing to blur, replace or mirror.

concerns: The card localizes to zero visible Persian text because the source design has none; a reviewer wanting an added Persian status label should know that would be new content, not localization.
Chinese code comments from upstream were intentionally left in the source (they never render on screen); the header comment documenting all RTL decisions is in English.
